text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky safely makes his debut. However, 
compared to her flashy classmates, she 
isn't drawing much attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she smirked, knowing everything 
was going according to plan. Hiding in the 
shadows, she decided to steadily build her 
strength in races she could win until 
reaching the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, she gets a call from her 
grandfather congratulating her on her 
debut. As Seiun Sky speaks with him, her 
expression softens in a way rarely seen.
